title: [Fri] Confirm official Saab brief and judging criteria
task: Read the official brief with the whole team. Copy challenge text, judging criteria and weights, time limit, deliverable rules and deadlines into docs/requirements.md section 1. Mark what changes in our plan.
dod: Section 1 of docs/requirements.md filled; changes recorded in docs/decisions.md; team told at checkpoint.

title: [Fri] Confirm available components and 3D-printing equipment
task: Fill docs/components.md with Have/Need. Ask organisers/MTC for missing parts. Confirm printer type, bed size, nozzle, materials, queue time.
dod: docs/components.md complete; missing items requested; printer access time agreed.

title: [Fri] Finalize minimum requirements (v1)
task: Review R1-R9 in docs/requirements.md against the official brief and available equipment. Adjust targets; freeze v1.
dod: Requirements table updated and agreed by all five; version noted.

title: [Fri] Create first CAD housing (v1)
task: Parametric housing with ballast cup, electronics compartment and lid. Use AI to draft, review manually. Fill the parameter table in cad/README.md. Log AI use.
dod: Model source in cad/models; STL in cad/exports/housing_v1.stl; slices without blocking errors (R6); AI log entry added.

title: [Fri] Verify electronics dimensions and send module envelope to CAD
task: Measure real parts (MCU, battery holder, button, LED). Define module envelope, mass and connector position. Fill the table in electronics/README.md and tell Person 1 face to face.
dod: Table filled with measured values; Person 1 confirms receipt.

title: [Fri] Build LED/button circuit (dry)
task: Breadboard: battery -> button -> MCU -> LED with resistor. Flash pattern in firmware. Test dry only.
dod: LED flashes when button pressed (video); firmware committed in electronics/firmware; wiring photo in electronics/wiring; logged in electronics/README.md.

title: [Fri] Prepare flotation mock-up and test setup
task: Build a quick mock-up (bottle/container + adjustable ballast) and a dummy module. Prepare tub, stopwatch, phone stand, scale. Run first tilt test to learn how it behaves.
dod: Mock-up floats test recorded in tests/test-results.md (clearly marked mock-up); test equipment checklist ticked.

title: [Fri] Research existing rescue products
task: Use AI + sources to list types of rescue beacons/locators and where they leave room for improvement. Every claim has a link; unverified claims go in the rejected table.
dod: docs/research.md has >= 5 sourced rows and a verified-facts list.

title: [Fri] Start the AI engineering log
task: Make sure everyone knows how to log AI use. Add first real entries. Share the template in Discord.
dod: At least 3 real entries in docs/ai-process.md; example entries still labeled or removed.

title: [Fri] Begin the presentation outline
task: Adapt presentation/pitch-outline.md to the official time limit. Draft slide titles. No numbers without a source or test.
dod: Time limit written in outline; slide titles drafted.

title: [Fri] Evening checkpoint: freeze v1 and plan Saturday
task: Review all Friday issues, update README status table, decide what moves to Saturday, drop stretch goals if behind.
dod: README status updated; Saturday plan agreed; blockers listed.

title: [Sat] Print or assemble the housing
task: Print housing v1 (or assemble fallback: bought container + printed module tray). Weigh it and record print time and issues.
dod: Physical housing exists; mass recorded; print problems logged.

title: [Sat] Test flotation and stability (T-R1, T-R1b, T-R2)
task: Unpowered housing with dummy module. 15 min float, tissue leak check, 5 tilt trials. Film and record every trial.
dod: Results and video links in tests/test-results.md, including failures.

title: [Sat] Integrate essential electronics into the module
task: Mount circuit and battery in the real module with the agreed connector.
dod: Module fits housing; powered unit works dry; photos taken.
deps: Build LED/button circuit; Print or assemble housing

title: [Sat] Test activation and LED functionality (T-R3)
task: Press button 5 times, time press-to-LED with phone video. Dry only.
dod: T-R3 recorded; Pass/Fail stated.

title: [Sat] Demonstrate modular electronics replacement (T-R4)
task: Write 3-5 step swap instructions. A teammate who did not design it swaps the module with a stopwatch.
dod: Swap time recorded and filmed; instructions in cad/README.md.

title: [Sat] Produce and test revised CAD design v2 (R8, T-R5)
role: Person 1 with AI; retest by Person 4
task: Take the worst v1 test result, ask AI for a change, review, change one parameter, print v2, repeat the same test. Follow the iteration procedure in docs/ai-process.md.
dod: v1 and v2 results side by side in tests/test-results.md; AI-log chain complete; cad iteration log updated.

title: [Sat] Document test results and limitations
task: Every requirement row Pass/Fail/Not tested with evidence. Write the limitations list.
dod: No blank rows in summary table; limitations section done (R7).

title: [Sat] Record backup demonstration footage
task: Film the full demo flow: CAD change, tilt/self-right, LED, module swap. Save on laptop and phone.
dod: Video plays offline from laptop and phone; linked in tests/test-results.md.

title: [Sat] Complete pitch and demo script
task: Finish slides, demo-script.md and qa-prep.md using real results. Assign who speaks when.
dod: Slides done; every claim traceable to results or sources; speakers assigned.

title: [Sat] STRETCH: ESP32 wireless alert + simple dashboard
task: Only start if all essential Saturday issues are Done or in final testing. Local Wi-Fi only, one status page. Kill rule: not working by Sat 16:00 -> drop.
dod: ACTIVE alert appears on laptop within 5 s, shown in a video; OR issue closed as dropped with reason in docs/decisions.md.

title: [Sat] STRETCH: Water-contact activation / battery indicator
task: Only after all essentials pass. Dry bench test only unless Person 2 signs off. Drop if it threatens the freeze.
dod: Works on the bench (video) or closed as dropped with reason.

title: [Sat] Freeze the final prototype
task: At the agreed time: tag main as `demo-freeze`, label the physical prototype, put a spare module aside. After freeze only docs, rehearsal and backups.
dod: Git tag created; prototype labeled; team confirms freeze.
deps: Revised design tested; backup footage recorded

title: [Sun] Rehearse the presentation (twice)
task: Rehearse with a timer, including the fallback demo and Q&A.
dod: Two timed run-throughs; time within limit.

title: [Sun] Check demonstration readiness
task: Tick every item in the readiness checklist in presentation/demo-script.md.
dod: Checklist fully ticked; spares packed.

title: [Sun] Present the product and testing evidence
task: Deliver the pitch and demo. Be honest about limits.
dod: Presentation delivered.

title: [Sun] Answer judges' questions
task: Use presentation/qa-prep.md. If we did not test it, say so.
dod: Q&A done; new questions noted for next time.
